gold: Macular retinal vein occlusion with chronic cystoid macular edema

selector.rationale: Severe macular changes with associated edema and changes in macular edema over the course of treatment support Cystoid Macular Edema, with Retinal Vein Occlusion being a possible underlying cause

rejected.label: Niacin-Induced Maculopathy
rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence for niacin-induced maculopathy as the primary cause

rejected.label: Hypertensive Retinopathy
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of hypertension, the primary findings suggest a more specific condition

rejected.label: Ischemic Optic Neuropathy
rejected.why: Vision loss and decreased visual acuity are not specific to ischemic optic neuropathy and are better explained by cystoid macular edema
